Field.name: InputFile
Field.usage: Input piece list or point file
Field.manpage: Input piece list or point file. If this option is not entered and -create is not entered, the first non-optional argument will be used for an input file.

Field.name: OutputFile
Field.usage: Output piece list or point file
Field.manpage: Output piece list or point file. If this option is not entered, the second non-optional argument will be used if -create is not entered; otherwise the first non-option argument will be used for an output file.

Field.name: CreateForSections
Field.usage: Number of sections to create a new piece list for
Field.manpage: Number of sections to create a new piece list for

Field.name: PiecesInXandY
Field.usage: Number of pieces in X and Y in the newly created piece list

Field.name: SpacingInXandY
Field.usage: Spacing between pieces in created piece list (- for inverse order)
Field.manpage: Spacing between the pieces in X and Y in the newly created piece list. Enter the negative of a spacing to have pieces coordinates put out in inverse order, from high to low coordinates. For how to determine the desired spacing, see above.

Field.name: ColumnsOfPieces
Field.usage: Order pieces in created piece list in columns instead of rows
Field.manpage: Order pieces in a newly created piece list so that successive pieces occur in columns (in Y) rather than in rows (in X).

Field.name: StacksOfPieces
Field.usage: 1 to order pieces in created piece list first by Z, -1 for inverse Z order
Field.manpage: Order pieces in a newly created piece list so that successive pieces go through the entire set of Z values at each position in X and Y. Enter 1 to have pieces in order by Z, or -1 for pieces in inverse order. This option can be used together with the -columns option.

Field.name: DivideByBinning
Field.usage: Adjust coordinates for images binned by the given factor
Field.manpage: This option can be used to make a new piece list that works with binned images. Rather than just dividing the existing coordinates by the binning, the program determines a new overlap value and makes sure that coordinates are regularly spaced apart. To do this, it needs the image sizes before and after binning, entered with -size and -binned.

Field.name: NewOverlapInXandY
Field.usage: Adjust coordinates to have the new overlap in X and Y
Field.manpage: This option can be used to change the overlap between pieces in a piece list. Enter the new overlaps in X and Y, and enter the size of the pieces with the -size option.

Field.name: SizeInXandY
Field.usage: Size of pieces in X and Y (required to adjust overlap or divide by binning)
Field.manpage: Size of pieces in X and Y. This entry is required to adjust overlap or to divide by binning; in the latter case enter the full size of the unbinned images to which the input piece list corresponds.

Field.name: BinnedSizeInXandY
Field.usage: New, binned size of pieces in X and Y (required to divide by binning)

Field.name: NewZList
Field.usage: List of Z values to map old list to
Field.manpage: List of Z values to map old list to. There must be as many values in this list as in the list of Z values to remap. See notes above on the contents of this list.

Field.name: AddToAllCoordinates
Field.usage: Amount to add to all coordinates in X, Y, and Z, after remapping

Field.name: ParameterFile
Field.manpage: Read parameter entries as keyword-value pairs from a parameter file.
